tools.name: decode
tools.description: Read a package barcode or tracking number (IMpb): its layout, each field's digits and meaning, whether the check digit holds, and the service type code's row in the USPS list, each with the passage that says so.

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Look up a USPS code: its row as USPS prints it in the newest edition that lists it, the codes its cells name, the editions that list it and its history, each row with its passage id.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: What changed in a code table or document between two editions: each code added, removed or changed and each changed section, rated editorial, additive or breaking, with who rated it.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the codes, terms, specs and documents postalref models, exact names and codes first. A query of 20 or more digits comes back as one to decode.

tools.name: define
tools.description: What USPS means by a name or abbreviation: each registry entry it names, with the USPS words that define it and the page they're on, its other names, postalref's own explanation where it has one, and postalref's page about it.

tools.name: read_source
tools.description: Read a revision of a modeled USPS document page by page, as extracted, to quote it: a quote cites the revision's sha256, the PDF page and the words exactly.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search every document on PostalPro by title and file name, with its page and newest file. postalref models a few of them; those carry a slug for read_source.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
